content.text:
I built the flyer and rendered all three sizes. The layout checker found no defects in any of them, and I didn't make any per-size edits.

- **Stretching and cropping:** The headline, the red call-to-action bar and the footer stretch to full width. The photo band stretches both ways and crops instead of distorting. It takes up the height differences between sizes, so it's shorter in wide and taller in sky.
- **Columns:** The three candidate columns scale with the width, so they stay evenly spaced.
- **Anchoring:** The candidates, call-to-action bar, steps and footer stay pinned to the bottom. The icon plus "VOTE BY MAIL" and the three check-mark steps stay centred.

Two things to look at before using it:

- **Small text in sky:** The footer is only 7.8px there. The candidate names and steps are also very small, so that size may be hard to read.
- **Headline line break in wide:** "Families" ends up alone on the second line.

Files are in `/var/folders/hf/35wnqrnj2bbb1_llbg87zlt40000gn/T/scene-mcp-e2e-llm-82828/renders/sfef253d8c2/`:
- `portrait-v4.png`
- `wide-v4.png`
- `sky-v4.png`
